This is a limited-data assessment. Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset, and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and is labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.
Real official data point: Hirzenbach sits in Kreis 12, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average of 2.31 break-ins a year per 1,000 premises — homes and workplaces together — in that district across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 71% of the 12-district average of 3.26 per 1,000 premises. Workplaces are counted because some districts hold far more of them than residents — Kreis 1 has 5,583 residents and 78,087 jobs — and dividing by residents alone made the old town read as the worst district in the city, which the counts behind it do not support. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Hirzenbach specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.

Frequently asked questions

Is Hirzenbach safe?

Wandroz currently rates Hirzenbach in Zurich as an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Hirzenbach safe at night?

At night, Hirzenbach is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zurich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Hirzenbach a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Hirzenbach's day rating (an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. The Booking.com link on this page searches Hirzenbach itself.

Is there any official crime data for Hirzenbach?

Partially. Hirzenbach sits in Kreis 12, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich publishes a real, current burglary rate for that district — 2.31 break-ins a year per 1,000 premises (homes and workplaces), 71% of the 12-district average. This covers burglaries only, not all crime types, and is reported at district level, not specifically for Hirzenbach — see the box below for the full figure and caveats.
